! Game text
| Deploy on Superlaser. To fire Superlaser at a planet, opponent must first 'charge' it by accumulating 8 Force cards here. When fired, Effect is canceled. If Effect canceled, accumulated Force is placed in Used Pile. || Deploy on {{Errata hl|1=a superlaser}}. {{Errata hl|1=May not fire at a planet until 'recharged.' Opponent may use Force (stacking it here); accumulating 8 Force recharges superlaser.}} When fired {{Errata hl|1=at a planet}}, Effect is canceled. If Effect canceled, accumulated Force is placed in Used Pile. || Deploy on a superlaser. May not fire at a planet {{Errata hl|1=unless 8 cards stacked here. If fewer than 8 cards stacked here, opponent may stack top card of Force Pile here}}. {{Errata hl|1=If just fired}} at a planet, Effect is canceled. If Effect canceled, {{Errata hl|1=cards stacked here are}} placed in Used Pile. || Deploy on a superlaser. May not fire at a planet unless 8 cards stacked here. If fewer than 8 cards stacked here, opponent may stack top card of Force Pile here. If just fired at a {{Errata hl|1=system}}, Effect is canceled. If Effect canceled, cards stacked here are placed in Used Pile.

== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English [[Commence Recharging]] original, [[Commence Recharging (Errata)]], [[Commence Recharging (PC Errata 4)]], and [[Commence Recharging (PC Errata 5)]] articles. Columns are Original · Decipher Errata (Glossary 2.0) · PC Errata (Appendix A / PC Errata 4) · PC Errata 5. Same-words Holotable (PC Errata, PC Errata 2, PC Errata 3) fold into Decipher Errata. Do not transclude onto Revised, Japanese, or (V). {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
